READ-ONLY SEO AUDIT

Children’s Dentistry of Chattanooga — SEO audit

Five specific fixes, with the evidence needed to review them.

October 5, 2026 · 42 sitemap pages checked · 62 crawl requests · No website changes

The hero animation weighs 31.9 MBSchema points to the wrong places“Next” returns to the same articleTwo useful pages have no site linksArticles do not name an authorFix order
01

The hero animation weighs 31.9 MB

The homepage’s first-screen #section-97-14 loads office-tour.webp, a 31.9 MB animated image with 696 frames, while Google’s mobile tests varied from 47 to 88/100 and under-recorded that download.

  • Keep the look with a lightweight first-paint poster and an efficiently encoded, responsive animation/video instead of the huge animated CSS image.
  • Retest the complete hero download and first-screen rendering; preserve image quality, tracking and script dependencies.
02

Schema points to the wrong places

The homepage’s hidden Dentist pin is about 69 km from the verified GBP location, eight Service providers use another pin about 13.5 km away, and business schema omits the weekday lunch closure.

  • Keep one accurate Dentist identity at 35.018876, -85.1605401 and make the eight Service providers refer to it; retain valid business and service markup.
  • Use Monday–Thursday 8–1 and 2–5, Friday 8–1, weekends closed; align doctor/article fields in the same schema cleanup using verified data.
03

“Next” returns to the same article

All 19 blog articles show “2” and “Next” links in Recent Posts that redirect back to the article instead of showing more posts.

  • Remove those pagination controls from the single-article Recent Posts template.
  • Use a “View all articles” link to /blog/ if needed; keep the existing article redirects and do not point to an unverified page-2 archive.

04

Two useful pages have no site links

The FAQ and Referrals pages are live and indexable but have no crawlable incoming links in the 42-page inventory, even though the FAQ received three Google clicks and 361 impressions in the checked month.

  • Link the approved FAQ from First Dental Visit and Contact, or a suitable patient-information menu; review overlap with the existing FAQs & Reviews page first.
  • Add “For Referring Doctors” in the footer/About navigation and a Contact-page link once the referral page is confirmed current.
05

Articles do not name an author

The 19 educational articles have no visible author or reviewer attribution or publication date in their shared article template.

  • Add the real, confirmed author or reviewer with a relevant biography link; do not automatically credit the dentist as author.
  • Show genuine publication/update dates and coordinate the matching Article schema within the single schema task.

Fix order

Start with the huge hero and incorrect business schema, then improve the article template and approved support-page paths.

  • Website: hero delivery, consolidated schema and Recent Posts controls.
  • Content/SEO: confirmed article attribution and support-page placement decisions.

Read-only public crawl, GSC/GA4, exact GBP and bounded keyword checks. Lab scores vary and do not fully measure the animated hero; real-user CWV is unavailable. No clinical-claim, backlink or geography-only booking findings are included.
